ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a bar chart of the population density of the old urban areas of the three cities City A, City B, and City C in 1982, 1990, and 2000, with the vertical axis unit being people/square kilometer. Then reason: the question stem states that the urban populations of the three cities are all above 5 million, and that the old urban areas all refer to the urban scope before the founding of New China, so the changes in population density of the old urban areas can be compared. When the level of urbanization development is relatively high, population and functions will diffuse toward near urban areas and distant urban areas, and the population density of old urban areas usually decreases. The population density of the old urban areas of City A and City B both decreases, indicating that population dispersal and urban outward expansion are relatively obvious; the population density of the old urban area of City C remains at a high level for a long time, indicating that population dispersal in the old urban area is not obvious, and that urban spatial expansion and the urbanization process are relatively lagging. Therefore, the city whose urbanization level is relatively lagging is City C.
